summary: Melar Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands SPAC, filed an 8-K regarding an update to the terms of its extension proposal for an extraordinary general meeting scheduled for June 16, 2026. The Sponsor will increase the maximum monthly contribution to the trust from $40,000 to $80,000 (retaining a $0.02 per unredeemed share cap) to fund the extension period needed to complete an initial business combination. This is a routine procedural update and does not represent a standalone special situation. No deal terms or M&A event are announced.
